faq.title: Frequently Asked Questions
faq.subtitle: Common questions about working with me

items.question: What if I'm not ready for a 2-6 month engagement?
items.answer: I'm flexible. I offer shorter 2-4 week assessments and 1-2 month quick wins for urgent issues. We can start small (assess your data architecture and identify top 3 cost drivers) and scale up based on results. Many clients start with a 4-week assessment and then extend to a full engagement once they see the ROI.

items.question: Can you work with our existing team?
items.answer: Absolutely. I integrate seamlessly with existing teams. In fact, I prefer working alongside your engineers because they know your systems best. I focus on knowledge transfer, so your team can maintain and extend the solutions after I leave. At National Bank, I led a team of 7 engineers, and the solutions are still running successfully today.

items.question: What if we only need help for 1-2 weeks?
items.answer: I offer focused 1-2 week consulting sprints for specific problems like 'fix our data quality pipeline' or 'optimize our Snowflake costs.' These are perfect for urgent issues. However, data architecture improvements typically deliver the best ROI over 2-6 months because we can implement comprehensive solutions, not just quick fixes.

items.question: How do you ensure ROI on data projects?
items.answer: I start every project by identifying measurable metrics: error reduction targets, cost savings goals, efficiency improvements. At National Bank, I delivered significant annual value by tracking specific KPIs (30% error reduction, 25% efficiency gain, 40% faster testing). You'll get weekly updates with these metrics so you see progress in real-time, not just at the end.

items.question: Do you work remotely or on-site?
items.answer: Both. I'm based in Paris and Montreal, but I work remotely with clients worldwide (Europe, North America). For critical phases or team workshops, I can travel on-site. Most of my work is remote, which keeps costs down and allows for flexible scheduling across time zones.

items.question: What makes you different from other data consultants?
items.answer: Three things: (1) I focus on ROI, not just technical implementation. Every solution I build directly ties to cost savings or quality improvements you can measure. (2) I move fast—I start within 1-2 weeks and deliver results quickly. (3) I build solutions your team can maintain. No vendor lock-in or mysterious black boxes. You own the code and knowledge.

items.question: What if the project doesn't deliver the expected ROI?
items.answer: I'm transparent about risks upfront. During the free discovery call, I'll tell you if I can realistically achieve your goals. I don't take on projects where I can't deliver value. If we discover during the engagement that the scope needs to change, we adjust the plan transparently. I set realistic expectations and deliver measurable results, which is why clients continue working with me.

testimonial.author: Sara Jorio
testimonial.text: I had the opportunity to collaborate with Fallou during his time at the Bank, and I want to highlight his technical expertise and understanding of business challenges. Fallou played a key role in modeling and scaling the 360 view, an essential analytical foundation for customer data. As a tech lead, he was able to mobilize the team and maintain focus to achieve the project's ambitious goals. Fallou also distinguished himself by implementing a data quality tool, contributing to strengthening the reliability and governance of information. This work required close collaboration with several external teams and varied expertise, including data architects and governance specialists. His ability to navigate this complex environment and bring stakeholders together was decisive for the success of the initiatives. In summary, Fallou combines technical competence, strategic vision, and collaborative leadership, qualities that make him a major asset for any large-scale project.
